anomalies.observed: The root sheet contains a 74LVC1G-series single-gate logic device (drawn as an XOR gate) placed inside/over the Power hierarchical sheet symbol. Its inputs are labeled Troj_XOR_A and Troj_XOR_B, its output Troj_XOR_Y, with VCC to +3V3 and GND to GND. On the MCU sheet, ESP32-C3 GPIO9 (pin 17) is wired to the net Troj_XOR_A.
anomalies.expected: The design specification describes only the ESP32-C3, three MAX31855 thermocouple channels, the TPS1H200AQDGNRQ1 heater switch, the TPS2121RUXR power mux, the AP63203WU buck, two fan-tach inputs, and a WS2812B LED. No XOR gate or 'Troj' net is part of the intended design, and GPIO9 is not listed as driving any such device.

evidence.quote: Root sheet: Power sheet symbol contains a 74LVC1G... gate with pins A(2), B(1), Y(4), GND(3), VCC(5); labels Troj_XOR_A, Troj_XOR_B, Troj_XOR_Y
MCU sheet: U1 pin 17 GPIO9 -> Troj_XOR_A

The board is a single ESP32-C3 based controller (U1, ESP32-C3-MINI-1) ... Reads up to 3 K-type thermocouples ... Drives a single heater output ... Monitors 2 fan tachometers ... Accepts power from either a 12 V barrel jack or USB-C 5 V ... and a single onboard WS2812B status LED (D1).

anomalies.impact: An unlisted logic gate is inserted into the design and tied to an ESP32-C3 GPIO. Depending on what Troj_XOR_B and Troj_XOR_Y connect to, this can alter or override a control/status signal, causing the board to behave differently from the intended firmware/hardware design.
